phoenix_dying_light.name: Dying Light
phoenix_dying_light.description: Phoenix deals %damage_pct%%% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a %radius% radius every second.
phoenix_dying_light.note0: Dying Light deals damage while Phoenix is transformed during Supernova.

phoenix_icarus_dive.name: Icarus Dive
phoenix_icarus_dive.description: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
phoenix_icarus_dive.lore: Though space is a familiar realm to this being, flight beneath the atmospheric dome brings unparalleled joy.
phoenix_icarus_dive.note0: The dive lasts for %dive_duration% seconds. It can be interrupted by reactivating the ability.

phoenix_fire_spirits.name: Fire Spirits
phoenix_fire_spirits.description: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
phoenix_fire_spirits.shard_description: Causes Fire Spirits to become a passive charge-based ability. Has 7 second replenish time.
phoenix_fire_spirits.note0: Spirits provide vision at the impact location for 1 second.
phoenix_fire_spirits.lore: A collapsing stellar core often emits fleeting pulses of sentient light.

phoenix_sun_ray.name: Sun Ray
phoenix_sun_ray.description: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
phoenix_sun_ray.shard_description: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.
phoenix_sun_ray.abilitydraft_note: In Ability Draft, Sun Ray movement is disabled.  The hero can only turn in place while Sun Ray is active.
phoenix_sun_ray.lore: Currents that carry stellar energy span no wider than a few atoms.
phoenix_sun_ray.note1: Effect ends if stunned, silenced, hexed, slept, or lifted.
phoenix_sun_ray.note2: Using items or other abilities does not cancel Sun Ray.
phoenix_sun_ray.toggle_move_description: Toggles slow forward movement during Sun Ray firing.
phoenix_sun_ray.toggle_move_note0: Sun Ray allows Phoenix to move over cliffs and trees.
phoenix_sun_ray.toggle_move_custom_description: Toggles slow forward movement during Sun Ray firing.
phoenix_sun_ray.toggle_move_custom_note0: Allows flying over obstacles and trees.

phoenix_sun_ray_toggle_move.name: Toggle Movement
phoenix_sun_ray_toggle_move.description: Toggles slow forward movement during Sun Ray firing.
phoenix_sun_ray_toggle_move.note0: Allows flying over obstacles and trees.

phoenix_supernova.name: Supernova
phoenix_supernova.description: The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After %abilityduration% seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
phoenix_supernova.scepter_description: Increases number of attacks to destroy Supernova and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.
phoenix_supernova.lore: The solar blaze of a supernova may be deadly, but from its flames burst infinite new rays.
